candidates.name: LIDAR Time Stamped Point Cloud
verified_facts: The EA point-cloud archive contains 3D x,y,z returns and attributes from site-specific LIDAR surveys, with DTM and DSM raster products derived from point-cloud processing.
Historic archiving means a matching point cloud may not exist for every raster surface model.
semantic_limits: Raw or classified point returns are not automatically the final bare-earth DTM pixel used in a parcel result; classification, processing and survey matching must be preserved.

candidates.name: National LIDAR Programme
verified_facts: The National LIDAR Programme captured England in survey blocks, with Phase 1 completed through February 2023 and repeat phases undertaken where updated elevation is required.
Multiple derived products are published for survey blocks through the Defra survey portal.
semantic_limits: National coverage or a newer programme phase does not prove which survey, pixel or product supplied a specific parcel result; block-level lineage must be resolved.
